findings.description: The KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic annual key rotation is disabled. This increases the risk associated with long-term use of a single cryptographic key material for encrypting audit trail data.

No key policy is defined for the KMS key, meaning it relies entirely on the default AWS-managed key policy which grants full access to the account root and effectively all IAM principals with appropriate IAM permissions. This can allow overly broad access to decrypt/encrypt audit trail data if IAM policies are not tightly controlled elsewhere.
